parameters.scope: Dense local brain patches from one Zenodo recording. Approximate image morphology, not recovered 3D biology.
parameters.independence: Images from the same anatomy seed share geometry; split datasets by anatomy seed.
parameters.brightness_model_note: Effective brightness and contrast trends fitted on four ROIs windows0..4 only. Temporal checking uses windows5..7 at the same locations; not spatial or animal generalization.

source_provenance.access: HTTP byte ranges; every decoded page IFD and strip layout verified
source_provenance.sampling_note: 8 evenly spaced 16-frame windows from one recording; not independent animals

mask_definition: Per-cell NAOMi optical contribution>=50% own peak, holes filled, peak>=2000 ADU, area5..60px. Instance TIFF: highest contributing eligible cell wins overlaps. NPZ preserves overlaps.
